title: Query count of an ordered NAND tree
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be disjoint sets of coordinates in a finite sign cube, and let the first and second finite decision trees use coordinates from $A$ and $B$, respectively. On an input $x$, the ordered NAND tree first runs the first tree and runs the second tree only if the first tree outputs $-1$. Its number of queries is the number made by the first tree plus zero if that tree outputs $1$, and otherwise the number made by the second tree.
hypotheses_covered: A and B are disjoint coordinate sets
The first tree uses coordinates in A and has sign outputs
The second tree uses coordinates in B and has sign outputs
The input is a sign assignment on the full finite coordinate set
